{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    # Sparse 0 background with three colored pairs of marker pixels, as in the example.
    h=rng.randint(6,22); w=rng.randint(4,14)
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    palette=[1,2,3,4,5]
    rng.shuffle(palette)
    # two endpoint markers per color; mostly use distinct rows, with one color defining
    # a short horizontal span and others defining stripes.
    used=set()
    for k in range(rng.randint(2,4)):
        c=palette[k]
        r1=rng.randrange(h)
        r2=rng.randrange(h)
        while r2==r1: r2=rng.randrange(h)
        # keep markers from colliding
        x1=rng.randrange(w); x2=rng.randrange(w)
        for r,x in [(r1,x1),(r2,x2)]:
            if (r,x) in used: continue
            g[r][x]=c; used.add((r,x))
    return g"}
